commit_message:
clk: mmp: pxa1908-apbc: Fix NULL vs IS_ERR() check

The devm_kzalloc() function returns NULL on error, not error pointers.
Fix the check.

Fixes: 51ce55919273 ("clk: mmp: Add Marvell PXA1908 APBC driver")
